b: we've been changing how we research b2b companies before sending cold emails. instead of just looking at their google rankings, we now check whether their brand actually comes up when potential customers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google Al Mode for recommendations. we usually run a few questions related to their industry and compare which companies get mentioned. it's interesting how some businesses get decent google traffic but barely appear in those answers, while smaller competitors keep coming up. also using Monid for some of these searches, along with its people search to find who's handling marketing at the companies we're researching. once we have a better idea of what's happening, we can decide whether there's something worth reaching out about. curious if anyone else is checking Al search visibility as part of their b2b prospect research,
